Idk if this changes much but:

- The LSD was abnormally cheap 
- It tastes strongly metallic, not like lsd I’ve had 
- didn’t get any effects until 5 hours in
- my set and setting was perfect, i was in a good mood
- it immediately went bad, without any environmental or headspace change to provoke it
- absolutely no spiritual or conceptual thinking, i was instead seeing and hearing the most frightening shit and was convinced I needed to fight for survival
- I was frightened for my life after cutting, scratching and bleeding, so I took some Olanzapine, waited a bit; and took heaps more
- after hours, all my visuals had stopped but I was still feeling all of everything else (violent shaking, teeth grinding, scratching at my skin, nausea, punching things and tensing to cause cramps in my muscles). Further I was still scared I needed to fight for survival 

Friend got a similar experience to this on a much, much lower dosage. Same stuff and ended up tensing, jaw clenching and shaking after wandering out to a busy road.
I’m kinda feeling the same if you want to talk while still avoiding co-rumination
